title: Noun に 帰ります (Noun ni kaerimasu)
shortExplanation: Express going back or returning to a place: 'to return to', 'to go back to'.
longExplanation: The grammar point 'Noun に 帰ります' is used to express physically going back or returning to a specific place. It can be translated as 'to go back to' or 'to return to' in English. The particle に indicates the destination of the return.

examples.jp: 夏休みが終わったら、学校に帰ります。
examples.romaji: Natsuyasumi ga owattara, gakkou ni kaerimasu.
examples.en: When summer vacation ends, I'll go back to school.

examples.jp: 買い物を終えたら、家に帰ります。
examples.romaji: Kaimono o oetara, ie ni kaerimasu.
examples.en: After finishing shopping, I will go back home.

examples.jp: 今週末、実家に帰ります。
examples.en: I'm going back to my parents' home this weekend.

examples.jp: 友達と旅行に行ったあと、東京に帰ります。
examples.romaji: Tomodachi to ryokou ni itta ato, Toukyou ni kaerimasu.
examples.en: After traveling with my friend, I'll return to Tokyo.
